request_fields: address? {street, number, neighborhood?, postal_code?, city?, state?} (since 2.201.0)
private: owner scoped, unverified, no payments; unknown fallback per ticket

local_address.request: Optional and additive: the address that POST /api/ocr published in merchant.address with local_address_version=1. Strict object; lengths in UTF-16 code units: street <=200, number <=40, neighborhood <=120, postal_code <=10, city <=100, state <=100. Unknown keys or longer values: 400 validation_error.
local_address.stored: Only for the private restaurant created or found by this call, the first valid one (later ones are ignored), in restaurant_local_addresses. Never in restaurants.address. Never with an RFC shaped as a natural person (including the generic ones). Invalid numbers (S/N, not starting with a digit) or postal codes are not stored. Retention: while the restaurant exists (decision 511).
local_address.response: Unchanged, with or without address: restaurant.address keeps its value (null for a private one).
local_address.internal: Aviso 3.1.0 section 6: data used only for the internal identification of the establishment is not visible to other users. The stored address is never in any API response (restaurant, mesa, statistics, OPS individual); it is only read by the cuisine sweep (services/cocinaRestaurantes.js). tests/ocr-direccion-http.test.js pins it.
